from itertools import combinations
from pysat.solvers import Glucose4

n = 21
# Variable for edge (i,j), i<j: index in lex order
edge_id = {}
idx = 0
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        idx += 1
        edge_id[(i,j)] = idx  # 1-indexed

solver = Glucose4()

# For each 5-subset, not all edges same color
for S in combinations(range(n), 5):
    edges = [edge_id[(a,b)] for a,b in combinations(S,2)]
    # not all 0 (red): at least one 1
    solver.add_clause(edges)
    # not all 1 (blue): at least one 0
    solver.add_clause([-e for e in edges])

print("solving...")
res = solver.solve()
print(res)
if res:
    model = solver.get_model()
    sol = [(1 if model[i] > 0 else 0) for i in range(210)]
    print(len(sol))
    # verify
    ok = True
    for S in combinations(range(n), 5):
        vals = [sol[edge_id[(a,b)]-1] for a,b in combinations(S,2)]
        if all(v==0 for v in vals) or all(v==1 for v in vals):
            ok = False
            break
    print("verified:", ok)
    print(sol)
